Cache

See guide: Installation & Quickstart

frdc cache clear

Remove cached per-user Julia 1.14 LMDB object cache directories

OptionShortTypeDefaultChoicesDescription
--format-fStringtabletable, csv, jsonOutput format
--output-oString""—Write to file instead of stdout
FlagShortDescription
--stale-only—Remove only inactive build-stamp caches, keeping the current stamp

Output tables: cache_clear_summary (Cache base directory, removed/kept stamp counts, and bytes freed)

frdc cache info

Inspect per-user Julia 1.14 LMDB object cache location, status, and footprint

OptionShortTypeDefaultChoicesDescription
--format-fStringtabletable, csv, jsonOutput format
--output-oString""—Write to file instead of stdout

Output tables: cache_info (Cache status, base/active directory, budget (FRDCCACHEMAXMB), entry count, and total size); `cacheentries` (Per-build-stamp objcache directories and sizes (when entries exist))
